name: Barbier.barbier
statement:
theorem barbier {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) :
    perimeter h = π * w

name: Barbier.contDiff_one_deriv
statement: lemma contDiff_one_deriv {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv h)

name: Barbier.curve_proj
statement:
theorem curve_proj (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (curve h θ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re = h θ

name: Barbier.curve_width
statement:
theorem curve_width {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((curve h θ - curve h (θ + π)) * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re = w

name: Barbier.deriv_curve
statement:
theorem deriv_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (curve h) θ = ((h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_curve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (curve h) (((h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) θ

name: Barbier.integral_deriv_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_deriv_deriv_eq_zero {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), deriv (deriv h) θ = 0

name: Barbier.integral_support_eq
statement:
theorem integral_support_eq {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hc : Continuous h)
    (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), h θ = π * w

name: Barbier.norm_deriv_curve
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = |h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ|

name: Barbier.norm_deriv_curve_of_convex
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_curve_of_convex {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ

name: Barbier.perimeter_eq_integral
statement:
theorem perimeter_eq_integral {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    perimeter h = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), h θ

name: Barbier.circle_constWidth
statement: theorem circle_constWidth (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) : ConstWidthSupport (fun _ => w / 2) w

name: Barbier.circle_perimeter
statement: theorem circle_perimeter (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) : perimeter (fun _ => w / 2) = π * w

name: Barbier.deriv_deriv_trefoil
statement:
lemma deriv_deriv_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (trefoil a b)) θ = -(9 * b) * Real.cos (3 * θ)

name: Barbier.deriv_trefoil
statement:
lemma deriv_trefoil (a b : ℝ) :
    deriv (trefoil a b) = fun θ => -(3 * b) * Real.sin (3 * θ)

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_trefoil
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (trefoil a b) (-(3 * b) * Real.sin (3 * θ)) θ

name: Barbier.trefoil_constWidth
statement:
theorem trefoil_constWidth {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : 8 * b ≤ a) :
    ConstWidthSupport (trefoil a b) (2 * a)

name: Barbier.trefoil_not_const
statement: theorem trefoil_not_const {a b : ℝ} (hb : b ≠ 0) : trefoil a b 0 ≠ trefoil a b (π / 3)

name: Barbier.trefoil_perimeter
statement:
theorem trefoil_perimeter {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : 8 * b ≤ a) :

name: Barbier.bridge_constWidth
statement:
theorem bridge_constWidth {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) :
    (∀ θ : ℝ, inner ℝ (curve h θ - curve h (θ + π)) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = w) ∧
    (∀ θ, ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) ∧ 0 ≤ w

name: Barbier.bridge_curve
statement:
theorem bridge_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (curve h θ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = h θ ∧
    inner ℝ (deriv (curve h) θ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = 0

name: Barbier.bridge_inner_exp
statement:
theorem bridge_inner_exp (z : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ z (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = (z * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re

name: Barbier.bridge_perimeter
statement:
theorem bridge_perimeter (r : ℝ) :
    curve (fun _ => r) = circleMap 0 r ∧ perimeter (fun _ => r) = 2 * π * |r|

name: Barbier.bridge_support
statement:
theorem bridge_support {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun φ => inner ℝ (curve h φ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) (h θ)

name: Barbier.bridge_trefoil
statement:
theorem bridge_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    trefoil a b θ + trefoil a b (θ + π) = 2 * a ∧
    trefoil a b θ + deriv (deriv (trefoil a b)) θ = a - 8 * b * Real.cos (3 * θ)

statement:
theorem support_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :

name: Barbier.width_body

theorem width_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :

theorem curve_mem_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :

statement:

name: Barbier.width_body_piecewise

name: Barbier.reuleaux_arc
statement:
theorem reuleaux_arc {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (5 * π / 6) (7 * π / 6),
      dist (curve (reuleaux w) θ) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_constWidth
statement: theorem reuleaux_constWidth {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) : PiecewiseConstWidth (reuleaux w) w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_not_smooth
statement: theorem reuleaux_not_smooth {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) : ¬ ContDiff ℝ 2 (reuleaux w)

name: Barbier.reuleaux_perimeter
statement: theorem reuleaux_perimeter {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) : perimeter (reuleaux w) = π * w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_period_pos
statement: lemma reuleaux_period_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3

name: Barbier.reuleaux_periodic
statement: lemma reuleaux_periodic (w : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (reuleaux w) (2 * Real.pi)

name: Barbier.reuleaux_vertices
statement:
theorem reuleaux_vertices {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) 0) (curve (reuleaux w) (2 * π / 3)) = w ∧
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (2 * π / 3)) (curve (reuleaux w) (4 * π / 3)) = w ∧
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (4 * π / 3)) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_width
statement: lemma reuleaux_width (w : ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : reuleaux w θ + reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) = w

name: Barbier.body_nonempty_piecewise
statement: theorem body_nonempty_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : (body h).Nonempty

name: Barbier.exists_convexBody_piecewise
statement:
theorem exists_convexBody_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = body h ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = h θ) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)

name: Barbier.isCompact_body_piecewise
statement: theorem isCompact_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : IsCompact (body h)

name: Barbier.reuleaux_convexBody
statement:
theorem reuleaux_convexBody {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = body (reuleaux w) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)

name: Barbier.l14_barbier_piecewise
statement:
theorem l14_barbier_piecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖) = π * w

name: Barbier.l14_body
statement:
theorem l14_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    Convex ℝ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
    ∀ θ : ℝ,
      IsGreatest (Set.range fun φ => inner ℝ ((fun t : ℝ =>
        ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) φ)
        (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) (h θ) ∧
      (fun t : ℝ => ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ ∈
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
      sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ})) = h θ ∧
      sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}))
      + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ})) = w

name: Barbier.l14_convexBody
statement:
theorem l14_convexBody {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    IsCompact (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
    (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}).Nonempty ∧
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = ⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ} ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = h θ) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)

name: Barbier.l14_reuleaux_convexBody
statement:
theorem l14_reuleaux_convexBody {w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 < w) {R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = ⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ} ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)

name: Barbier.l14_toPiecewise
statement:
theorem l14_toPiecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ Function.Periodic h (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)

name: Barbier.l14b_body
statement:
theorem l14b_body (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) = body h

statement:
theorem l14b_constWidth {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) : ConstWidthSupport h w

name: Barbier.l14b_contDiff_curve
statement: theorem l14b_contDiff_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (curve h)

name: Barbier.l14b_curve
statement:
theorem l14b_curve (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ => ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      = curve h

name: Barbier.l14b_perimeter
statement:
theorem l14b_perimeter (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖)
      = perimeter h

name: Barbier.l14b_piecewise
statement:
theorem l14b_piecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    PiecewiseConstWidth h w

name: Barbier.l14b_piecewise_iff
statement:
theorem l14b_piecewise_iff {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} : PiecewiseConstWidth h w ↔
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ Function.Periodic h (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π))

name: Barbier.l14b_reuleaux
statement:
theorem l14b_reuleaux {w : ℝ} {R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) :
    R = reuleaux w

name: Barbier.l14w_barbier
statement:
theorem l14w_barbier :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) ∧ Function.Periodic (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (2 * π) ∧
    (∀ θ, (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) θ + (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (θ + π) = 4) ∧
    (∀ θ, 0 ≤ (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) θ + deriv (deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ))) θ) ∧
    (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) 0 ≠ (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => (((fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℂ) + ((deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => (((fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℂ) + ((deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) π ∧
    0 < π * 4

name: Barbier.l14w_length
statement:
theorem l14w_length :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) ∧ (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 1 ∧
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) t‖) = 1

name: Barbier.l14w_reuleaux
statement:
theorem l14w_reuleaux :
    ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (1 / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else 1 - (1 / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) ∧
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 R ∧ Function.Periodic R (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, R θ + R (θ + π) = 1) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv R) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) ∧
    ¬ ContDiff ℝ 2 R ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (4 * π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (4 * π / 3) ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ∈ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ}) ∧ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ∈ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ}) ∧
    0 < π * 1

name: Barbier.Classical.E_apply0
statement: lemma E_apply0 (z : ℂ) : (E z) 0 = z.re

name: Barbier.Classical.E_apply1
statement: lemma E_apply1 (z : ℂ) : (E z) 1 = z.im

name: Barbier.Classical.E_curve
statement:
lemma E_curve (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    E (Barbier.curve h θ) = !₂[h θ * Real.cos θ - deriv h θ * Real.sin θ,
                               h θ * Real.sin θ + deriv h θ * Real.cos θ]

name: Barbier.Classical.angle_equilateral
statement:
lemma angle_equilateral (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) :
    EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = π / 3

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_a_support
statement: theorem cov_C1_a_support : classical_C1_a_support

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_b_equiv_part
statement:
theorem cov_C1_b_equiv_part (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    Barbier.perimeter h = Barbier.perimeter (fun _ => w / 2)

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_b_part
statement:
theorem cov_C1_b_part (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    IsCompact (E '' body h) ∧ Convex ℝ (E '' body h) ∧ HasConstantWidth (E '' body h) w ∧
      Barbier.perimeter h = π * w

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_a_part
statement:
theorem cov_C2_a_part (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (reuleauxTriangle A B C w) ∧
      (¬ ∃ (c : Plane) (r : ℝ), reuleauxTriangle A B C w = Metric.closedBall c r)

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_boundary_part
statement:
theorem cov_C2_boundary_part (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = π / 3 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle C B A = π / 3 ∧
      EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B = π / 3

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_c_disk_area
statement:
theorem cov_C2_c_disk_area (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) (w / 2)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w ^ 2 / 4)

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_reuleaux_polygon_part
statement:
theorem cov_C2_reuleaux_polygon_part (m : ℕ) (v : Fin (2 * m + 1) → Plane) (w : ℝ)
    (hv : IsReuleauxPolygonData m v w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (⋂ i, Metric.closedBall (v i) w)

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_supportFn_obligation
statement: theorem cov_supportFn_obligation : obl_supportFn

name: Barbier.Classical.curveLength_E
statement:
lemma curveLength_E (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (T : ℝ) :
    curveLength (fun s => E (γ s)) T = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..T, ‖deriv γ t‖

name: Barbier.Classical.deriv_E_comp
statement: lemma deriv_E_comp (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun s => E (γ s)) t = E (deriv γ t)

name: Barbier.Classical.hasConstantWidth_E_body
statement:
lemma hasConstantWidth_E_body (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    HasConstantWidth (E '' body h) w

name: Barbier.Classical.isPlaneConvexBody_iInter
statement:
theorem isPlaneConvexBody_iInter {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → Plane) (w : ℝ)
    (hw : 0 < w) (hd : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (⋂ i, Metric.closedBall (v i) w)

name: Barbier.Classical.isPlaneConvexBody_reuleaux
statement:
theorem isPlaneConvexBody_reuleaux (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (reuleauxTriangle A B C w)

name: Barbier.Classical.reuleauxTriangle_eq
statement:
lemma reuleauxTriangle_eq (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) :
    reuleauxTriangle A B C w = ⋂ i : Fin 3, Metric.closedBall (![A, B, C] i) w

name: Barbier.Classical.reuleaux_not_disk
statement:
theorem reuleaux_not_disk (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    ¬ ∃ (c : Plane) (r : ℝ), reuleauxTriangle A B C w = Metric.closedBall c r

name: Barbier.Classical.supportFn_E_body
statement:
lemma supportFn_E_body (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    supportFn (E '' body h) (E (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) = h θ

name: Barbier.Classical.unit_eq_E_exp
statement:
lemma unit_eq_E_exp (u : Plane) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    u = E (Complex.exp ((Complex.arg (E.symm u) : ℝ) * Complex.I))

name: Barbier.Classical.vertex_near_center
statement:
lemma vertex_near_center {R : Set Plane} {X c : Plane} {r w : ℝ} (hR : R = Metric.closedBall c r)
    (hX : X ∈ R) (hsub : R ⊆ Metric.closedBall X w) : dist c X ≤ w / 2
